moves.name: Endure Harm
moves.trigger: When you **face physical damage**, suffer [-harm health](harm:health) — equal to your foe's rank, or as appropriate to the situation. Then, roll **+health** or **+iron**, whichever is higher.
moves.strong:
Choose one:
- Shake it off: If your health is greater than 0, suffer [-1 momentum](resource:momentum?value=-1) in exchange for [+1 health](resource:health?value=+1).
- Embrace the pain: Take [+1 momentum](resource:momentum?value=+1).
moves.weak: You press on. No additional penalty.
moves.miss: Also suffer [−1 momentum](resource:momentum?value=-1). If you are at 0 health, you must mark [wounded](debility:wounded?value=1) or [maimed](debility:maimed?value=1) (if currently unmarked) or roll on the [Endure Extreme Harm oracle](oracle:endureExtremeHarm).
moves.notes: Triggered every time you take harm — not just in combat. If health hits 0 on a miss, mark Wounded or Maimed (if unmarked) or roll on the Endure Extreme Harm oracle. Debilities reduce your stats. This is how characters die.

moves.name: Companion Endure Harm
moves.triggerShort: When your companion faces physical damage.
moves.trigger: When your **companion faces physical damage**, they suffer −health equal to the amount of harm inflicted. If your companion's health is 0, exchange any leftover −health for −momentum. Then, roll **+heart** or **+your companion's health**, whichever is higher.
moves.strong: Your companion rallies. Give them [+1 health](resource:health?value=+1).
moves.weak: Your companion is battered. If their health is 0, they cannot assist you until they gain at least [+1 health](resource:health?value=+1).
moves.miss: Also suffer [−1 momentum](resource:momentum?value=-1). If your companion's health is 0, they are gravely wounded and out of action. Without aid, they die in an hour or two. If you roll a miss with a **1 on your action die**, and your companion's health is 0, they are now dead. Take 1 experience for each marked ability on your companion asset, and remove it.
moves.notes: Roll +heart or +companion health, whichever is higher. A dead companion (miss with action die 1 at 0 health) is permanent — remove the asset and gain experience equal to its marked abilities.

moves.name: Face Death
moves.triggerShort: When you are brought to the brink of death.
moves.trigger: When you are **brought to the brink of death**, and glimpse the world beyond, roll **+heart**.
moves.strong: Death rejects you. You are cast back into the mortal world.
moves.weak:
Choose one:
- You die, but not before making a noble sacrifice. Envision your final moments.
- Death desires something of you in exchange for your life. Envision what it wants ([Ask the Oracle](move:ask-the-oracle) if unsure), and [Swear an Iron Vow](move:swear-an-iron-vow) (formidable or extreme) to complete that quest. If you fail to score a hit when you Swear an Iron Vow, or refuse the quest, you are dead. Otherwise, you return to the mortal world and are now [cursed](debility:cursed?value=1). You may only clear the cursed debility by completing the quest.
moves.notes: Triggered when health reaches 0 and you fail Endure Harm (or choose to Face Death directly). On a weak hit you can choose a noble sacrifice or accept a death-quest — the quest marks you cursed until completed.

moves.name: Face a Setback
moves.triggerShort: When your momentum is at -6 and you suffer additional -momentum.
moves.trigger:
When your **momentum is at its minimum (-6)**, and you suffer additional **-momentum**, choose one.
- Exchange each additional -momentum for any combination of [-health](resource:health?value=-1), [-spirit](resource:spirit?value=-1), or [-supply](resource:supply?value=-1) as appropriate to the circumstances.
- Envision an event or discovery ([Ask the Oracle](move:ask-the-oracle) if unsure) which undermines your progress in a current quest, journey, or fight. Then, for each additional -momentum, clear 1 unit of progress on that track per its rank (troublesome = clear 3 progress; dangerous = clear 2 progress; formidable = clear 1 progress; extreme = clear 2 ticks; epic = clear 1 tick).
moves.notes: No roll — automatically triggered when momentum is already at -6 and you would suffer more -momentum. You must absorb the overflow as either stat damage or progress loss. This is how bad situations spiral.

moves.name: Endure Stress
moves.triggerShort: When you face mental shock or despair.
moves.trigger: When you **face mental shock or despair**, suffer [-harm spirit](harm:spirit) — equal to your foe's rank, or as appropriate to the situation. Then roll **+heart** or **+spirit**, whichever is higher.
moves.strong:
Choose one:
- Shake it off: If your spirit is greater than 0, suffer [−1 momentum](resource:momentum?value=-1) in exchange for [+1 spirit](resource:spirit?value=+1).
- Embrace the darkness: Take [+1 momentum](resource:momentum?value=+1).
moves.miss: Also suffer [−1 momentum](resource:momentum?value=-1). If you are at 0 spirit, you must mark [shaken](debility:shaken?value=1) or [corrupted](debility:corrupted?value=1) (if currently unmarked) or roll on the [Endure Extreme Stress oracle](oracle:endureExtremeStress).
moves.notes: The spirit equivalent of Endure Harm. Roll +heart or +spirit, whichever is higher. If spirit hits 0 on a miss, mark Shaken or Corrupted (if unmarked) or roll on the Endure Extreme Stress oracle.

moves.name: Face Desolation
moves.triggerShort: When you are brought to the brink of desolation.
moves.trigger: When you are **brought to the brink of desolation**, roll **+heart**.
moves.weak:
Choose one:
- Your spirit or sanity breaks, but not before you make a noble sacrifice. Envision your final moments.
- You see a vision of a dreaded event coming to pass. Envision that dark future ([Ask the Oracle](move:ask-the-oracle) if unsure), and [Swear an Iron Vow](move:swear-an-iron-vow) (formidable or extreme) to prevent it. If you fail to score a hit when you Swear an Iron Vow, or refuse the quest, you are lost. Otherwise, you return to your senses and are now [tormented](debility:tormented?value=1). You may only clear the tormented debility by completing the quest.
moves.miss: You succumb to despair or horror and are lost.
moves.notes: The spirit equivalent of Face Death. Triggered when spirit reaches 0 and Endure Stress fails. On a weak hit you can choose a noble sacrifice or accept a quest to prevent a dark future — the quest marks you tormented until completed.

moves.name: Out of Supply
moves.trigger: When your **supply is exhausted** (reduced to 0), mark [unprepared](debility:unprepared?value=1). If you suffer additional -supply while unprepared, you must exchange each additional -supply for any combination of [-health](resource:health?value=-1), [-spirit](resource:spirit?value=-1), or [-momentum](resource:momentum?value=-1) as appropriate to the circumstances.
moves.notes: No roll — automatically triggered when supply hits 0. You immediately mark the unprepared debility. Any further -supply costs must be absorbed as -health, -spirit, or -momentum.
